candidate.description: This U inherits Parent 0's dispersion-weighted initial 0/8 and later 8/9 mixtures, while incorporating Parent 1's low-availability, workload-dispersion, late-progress, machine-dispersion, and default member mappings. Conflicts are resolved by prioritizing the workload/availability exceptions, then late-progress behavior, before applying the Parent 0 transition or machine-dispersion fallback.
